name: The Armadillo and The Princess
source:
The distant and cold planet of Cheantas has many secrets stored away. Deep, dark and painful secrets that lay dormant in the mind of Queen 634 Thiglnoom.  

What happened to her parents, very few know. But it's a story that she'll never be able to forget.

[from [url=https://drcllemlon.itch.io/the-armadillo-and-the-princess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
遥远而寒冷的奇塔斯星球上隐藏着许多秘密。深沉、黑暗和痛苦的秘密潜伏在634 Thiglnoom女王的脑海中。

她父母的遭遇，很少有人知道。但这是一个她永远无法忘记的故事。

[来自[url=https://drcllemlon.itch.io/the-armadillo-and-the-princess]itch.io[/url]]
